On the first half of the phase, Kefka will spawn Chaos (NW) and
Neo Exdeath (NE) on the edge of the arena. 

Kefka will cast 3 Mistery Magic in succession (same mechanic as P1, 
you have to deal with real/fake thunder/ice AOEs).

At the same time Chaos and Neo Exdeath will do their own casts that
apply debuffs to the players.
These casts can be real or fake (each boss will have a ring with
spinning orbs).
If the casts are fake, the effects of the debuffs are reversed.

The debuffs shown in the previous slides are applied in 2 sets
when Neo Exdeath casts the first 2 "Grand Cross".

The result will always be:
- 1 support and 1 DPS with short duration stack
- 1 support and 1 DPS with long duration stack
- 1 support and 1 DPS with short duration gaze
- 1 support and 1 DPS with long duration gaze
- 2 support and 2 DPS with short duration stillness 
- 2 support and 2 DPS with long duration stillness

Tese debuffs can also be fake but you don't need to pay attention to that
